rationale: Live UA payments trade hub that continuously republishes vendor/bank announcements; standalone monitorable feed.
Ukrainian banking/fintech trade outlet with recurring bank-side deal confirmation; complements psm7.
Vendor blog announcing terminal/POS certifications — early indicator of models entering deployment.
Static product section of privatbank.ua already covered by monitoring the bank domain; useful fleet context, not its own feed.
Global self-service/ATM trade media; occasional CEE-UA deployment items, low UA-specific yield.
EMA member list enumerates the UA card/payments buyer universe — mine once as master actor list.
EMA partner list maps the supply side positioning ahead of bank tenders; one-shot extraction.
Canonical NABU member-bank roster, very high value but URL check failed — recheck liveness before mining.
Single event announcement page, not a recurring feed; also unverified URL.
AUB member roster and council page name banks plus procurement-relevant executives; mine once.
UCBS extends actor map to mid-tier institutions but URL verification failed — recheck reachability.
UAFIC fintech catalogue PDF is a rich one-shot vendor enumeration; legally allowed, re-pull on new edition.
Flagship UA fintech conference site; agenda and sponsor tiers refresh annually and signal budgeted programmes.
Single-edition programme page on fintechua.org; monitor the association domain rather than the year page.
One event entry within the IT Ukraine events calendar; monitor the calendar as parent.
Committee membership names likely bidders/integrators for bank IT tenders; extract once.
EBA Electronic Payments Committee lists payments members and NBU-facing positions; mine roster, watch parent for updates.
One-off summit announcement article; strong evidence on planned A2A/SEPA/open-banking spend, parent psm7 already monitored.
Awards shortlists give a curated vendor/project map; mine periodically rather than monitor continuously.
LinkedIn post behind login/anti-bot walls; low incremental value over the organiser's own site.
Work.ua tender/procurement job searches are a durable pre-tender intent feed from banks and suppliers.
Robota.ua complements work.ua with different employer coverage for procurement/tender roles.
Jooble aggregation widens employer discovery beyond the two main boards; some duplication expected.
DOU combines bank/fintech IT vacancies with a maintained fintech events calendar; public and durable.
